prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 3:4 vertical long-lens nature lifestyle photograph of an adult man with wind-softened hair and a focused peaceful expression. He wears a dark textured overshirt, plain black T-shirt, dark trousers, and plain white trainers, seated upright but relaxed in a black folding camp chair while reading an open blank-page book. Place him small within a wide grassy field and gentle green hill, photographed from behind foreground grass and shrubs with a leafy branch in one corner. Use a 135mm view, large soft green bokeh foreground, crisp subject, soft even lightly-cloudy afternoon light, natural grass texture, realistic posture, and gentle color contrast. No exact face/hair preservation, shoe brand, earphone logo, readable book text, watermark, or logo.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, exact identity preservation, explicit, nsfw, logo, branded shoe, readable book text, watermark, distorted hands, unnatural pose, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity reference must depict a consenting adult. Clothing, chair, book, and meadow references are replaceable; omit every brand and readable page.
